what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Odoo's agents can write to the system of record; our stack fits around every Odoo, from 12 to 20.
sections.para: An ephemeral proof of concept went from nothing to customised in under a minute on four versions.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Odoo agents write; policies, an Odoo cell, vaults and keys; every version; use the future now.

sections.label: Why Odoo, and why now
sections.line: Odoo 20 agents create and update records from automated and scheduled actions, with a native MCP server.
sections.para: Agents now execute in many small companies' system of record.

sections.label: Where the gap is
sections.line: Power comes from tools and the user behind them; approvals are per agent; conversations last 30 days.
sections.para: The gap every agent platform has.

sections.label: RiskMandate: a behaviour policy for every Odoo agent
sections.line: A behaviour policy per Odoo agent: grant, mandate, gap and barrier; Odoo's access rights are the boundary.
sections.para: An Odoo module could measure the grant automatically.

sections.label: AgentiCCells: an Odoo cell
sections.line: An Odoo cell on AgentiCCells' ladder, from one workflow at £500 to a network at £20,000.
sections.para: The factory can make sites that read from Odoo.

sections.label: SGit and PKI: plan, then apply, with a record that lasts
sections.line: Agents plan in a vault, a person signs, a broker applies through the API, and the record lasts.

sections.label: SHarness, VoiceDebrief and PrompTugal.news
sections.line: SHarness around the Odoo server, VoiceDebrief into the CRM, PrompTugal.news with local businesses.

sections.label: Every version, not just 20
sections.line: Every Odoo since 12 has an API: XML-RPC, keys from 14, JSON-2 from 19, MCP from 20.
sections.para: An old Odoo full of real data is the better data source.

sections.label: A proof of concept, in under a minute
sections.line: Odoo 19, 18, 15 and 12, each from nothing to customised in under a minute, then removed.
sections.para: The same agent on all four; only its calls adapt.

sections.label: Use the future now
sections.line: Customers need not wait for the upgrade: we bring agents and policies to what they run now.
sections.para: And use Odoo's own agents when they arrive.

sections.label: The plan
sections.line: The proof of concept is done; next a copy of a real customer's Odoo, the broker, the offer, partners.

sections.label: What to watch
sections.line: Odoo moves fast; plan gates; legacy RPC deprecated, so use what each version has.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: A strategy and a proof of concept on Community images; Odoo 20 and Enterprise untested.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Odoo's release notes, integrators' summaries, Odoo's documentation, and earlier articles.
